caseName: Klehr v. A. O. Smith Corp.
caseNameFull: Klehr et ux. v. A. O. Smith Corp.

opinions.text: C. A. 8th Cir. Certiorari granted. Brief of petitioners is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Friday, February 21, 1997. Brief of respondents is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Friday, March 21, 1997. A reply brief, if any, may be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Monday, April 7,1997. This Court’s Rule 29.2 does not apply.
